app.tagline: Understand it. Don't just memorize it.

signin.title: Welcome to Lumo
signin.subtitle: Turn your notes into quizzes that help you truly understand.
signin.privacy: We never show your email or real name to other students.

errors.wrong_code: That code is wrong or expired.
errors.invalid_code: Enter the 6 digits from the email.
errors.google: Google sign-in didn't work. Try again.
errors.network: Can't reach Lumo. Check your connection.

home.streakNone: Study today to light your first streak flame.
home.streakSafe: Your streak is safe today. Lumo is glowing!
home.streakAtRisk: Study today to keep your {{count}}-day streak!
home.streakBroken: Your streak went out. Let's light a new one!
home.createBody: Send photos of your notes and tell me about your exam.
home.reviewBody: Practice, review and fix mistakes — new questions every time.

profile.title: My profile
profile.usernameHint: 3–20 letters, numbers or _. No real names or birth years.

errors.username_personal_info: Keep personal info (like birth years) out of your username.

settings.title: Settings
settings.privacyBody: Your uploads are only used to make your decks. You can delete everything at any time.
settings.deleteConfirm: This permanently deletes your account, decks and progress. Type DELETE to confirm.

learn.title: My decks
learn.emptyBody: Soon you’ll make decks by chatting with Lumo. For now, try a sample deck!

deck.notFound: This deck doesn’t exist (or isn’t yours).
deck.practiceBody: A fresh mix of questions, new every time.
deck.challengeBody: Wrong answers cost a heart. Show what you know!
deck.noHearts: No hearts left — do a Review to refill.
deck.masteryRule: A concept is mastered when you’ve got it right in 3 different question types, at more than one level of depth.

quiz.notQuite: Not quite — let’s learn from it
quiz.retrySoon: You’ll see this idea again soon, asked a different way.
quiz.teachPlaceholder: Explain it to Lumo like a friend…
quiz.explainPlaceholder: Write it in your own words…
quiz.ownWords: Your own words count — no need to match the textbook.
quiz.dragHint: Drag each item to the right place — or tap it, then tap where it goes.
quiz.allPlaced: All placed! Tap an item to move it.
quiz.orderHint: Drag the steps, or use the arrows, to put them in order.
quiz.tapMistakeFirst: First tap the part that’s wrong
quiz.sessionDoneBody: Every question was new — that’s how real understanding grows.
quiz.outOfHeartsBody: No worries! Do a Review session to refill hearts — learning never stops.

errors.no_hearts: No hearts left. Try a Review session to refill them.
errors.no_questions: Couldn’t make questions for this deck.
errors.invalid_answer: That answer couldn’t be read. Try again.
errors.network: Can’t reach Lumo. Check your connection.
